info.description: Site-wide announcement banner with time-bound display.

linkUrl.description: Optional URL for the call-to-action link.

backgroundColor.description: Background color for the banner (hex code).

textColor.description: Text color for the banner (hex code).

isActive.description: Whether the announcement is currently active.

startDate.description: Optional start date for the announcement.

endDate.description: Optional end date for the announcement.

isDismissible.description: Whether users can dismiss the announcement.
